findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: The air vents in the kitchen are observed to have an accumulation of dust/debris. These vents need to be cleaned to remove the apparent build-up. Ensure the physical facilities are cleaned at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean.
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

(REPEAT) Observed the soda nozzle holders to have accumulation of mold. Discussed with PIC - wash, rinse, sanitize frequently to avoid mold. COS. This is a repeat violation since the last routine inspection on 11/19/19.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
4-101.19: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other FOOD soiling or that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a CORROSION-RESISTANT, nonabsorbent, and SMOOTH material. 

Observed large reach-in freezer within kitchen to have accumulation of frost build-up. Discussed routine cleaning with PIC.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A)  (Pf) Observed ice machines at the drop guards and soda gun at the bar to be soiled with dust, dirt, food residue and other debris. Wash, rinse, sanitize food-contact surfaces routinely. Reference 4-601.11(A). Clean and maintain clean.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: Observed mold in the ice machine and in the soda gun at the bar. Maintain free of accumulated soil. 750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: The ice machine behind the bar has some mold soil. 750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use and any time they may have become contaminated. Properly clean the ice machine and maintain clean.  .

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.citation_text: 750.830 g No QUAT or Chlorine test kit was available to use during the inspection. Provide test kits.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment:
Observed no thermometer in the reach in bar cooler that holds juice.  Place a thermometer in the cooler.
750-230 A calibratable metal-stemmed thermometer accurate to ±2F° shall be provided for checking temperatures on food.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed a leak at the three compartment sink in bar area when the faucet is turned on.  Repair the leak.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed the floor mat next to the fryers to be soiled.  Clean the mat.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Observed an absence of caulk at the handwashing sink.  Re-caulk the handsink to the wall.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment: 750.   1) Observed cooked hot dogs with no date. 2) Observed ham in a bag with a date of 03/12/2013( reach in cooler)  3) Observed strawberries in walk in cooler dated 04/21/2013. All items were discarded during the inspection. Facility cannot reheat food. Date mark all foods and discard food after seven days.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: 750.140a  Absence of thermometer in bar cooler that holds juice. Replace thermometer so that it can visibliy be seen.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
750.800b (REPEAT)  Observed both soda guns in the bar to be soiled, as well as the gun holder above handsink. Clean and sanitize food contact surfaces often.
2) Observed pink mold on ice machine flap in kitchen. Clean and sanitize.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment: 750.880b Observed single service containers food side up. Invert containers to prevent cross contamination.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.citation_text: 750.1060 1) Observed a leak at three compartment sink when faucet is turned on (faucet attached with a spray hose)  2) Observed a leak at the three compartment sink in bar area when faucet is turned on. Repair the leaks.

findings.title: Presence of insects/rodents.  Animals prohibited
findings.comment: 750.1160: Observed new and old larva, possible from fruit flies, in the soda gun holder at bar by handsink.  This soda gun and holder were cleaned and sanitized during inspection. Clean often.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment: 750.140b: Absence of date labels on prepared foods such as pasta and potato salad in the refrigerator. Staff states they are left over from event on Saturday. Label and discard after 7 days from prep.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
750.800b: *Observed plastic piece inside small ice machine in bar has some mold. Clean plastic piece in ice machine.
*Observed both soda guns in the bar to be soiled, as well as the soda gun holder above the handsink.  Clean and sanitize food contact surfaces often.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750.800b: Observed the following food contact surfaces to be soiled: 1. Soda gun holder on the bar, by the 3 compartment sink  2. Metal piece inside the ice machine is soiled with mold.  Clean and sanitize above mentioned items.

findings.title: Approved source
findings.comment: 100     There were baked beans, grean beans, and hot dogs in the walk-in cooler that had been previously prepared and cooled for possible resevice.   The Club's medium risk food license does not allow for the cooling and re-heating of potentially hazardous food.   The pans of food were dumped in the Clubs dumpster.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment:
Silverware in drawers was not aligned so the silverware would only be touched by their handles.
750-850 Cleaned and sanitized equipment and utensils shall be handled in a way that protects them from contamination.  Spoons, knives and forks shall be touched only by their handles.   Store the silverware with handles aligned in the same direction.
